current_goal: Develop and validate a host-neutral personal capture runtime reference implementation for all-domain work and life sources while keeping the Agent Skill portable and the overall system experimental; this is not a final personal digital foundation platform.

ontology_layering.principle: shared semantic core + scope-specific extensions + separate governance and policy boundaries

out_of_scope: claiming an enterprise-grade personal data platform
claiming automatic capture without an authorized host connector
claiming native DingTalk or recorder integration
claiming a production consent service or cryptographic key management
automatically sharing personal records with an enterprise or center ontology
claiming live microphone, camera, location or desktop capture
claiming remote multi-agent access or multi-device synchronization
claiming production-grade encryption, identity, consent or deletion guarantees
release_gates: Skill frontmatter and stage profile agree on versions and maturity
all skipped or unavailable tests are explicitly reported
no new stable ontology terms are introduced in this release
12-case synthetic cross-host benchmark package is internally valid
cross-host claims require at least two actual host environments and recorded runs
critical failures are zero before claiming a host passed
benchmark scores require human review; structural evaluator is not a semantic judge
capture runtime unit tests pass using synthetic data
manual ingestion, provenance, schema validation, consent denial and deletion are verified
provider connectors and ambient device capture are not claimed as implemented
runtime API remains loopback-only until authentication, TLS and deployment security are reviewed

cross_host_validation.claim_policy: Do not claim cross-agent validation passed until actual outputs from at least two distinct host environments are recorded and reviewed.
cross_host_validation.prompt_leakage_control: agent receives prompts only; evaluator case metadata remains separate
